snippet.title: 1995 Street Fighter: The Movie ( PSX) Old School retro game playthrough 60fps
snippet.description: Street Fighter: The Movie, released in Japan as Street Fighter: Real Battle on Film (ストリートファイター リアルバトル オン フィルム?), is a head-to-head fighting game released for the PlayStation and Sega Saturn in 1995.[1] The game is based on the 1994 live-action Street Fighter movie and uses digitized images of the film's cast posing as the characters in the game. While it shares its title with the arcade game Street Fighter: The Movie, the home version is not a port but a similar game developed on the same premise.[2] The home version was developed and published by Capcom in Japan and released in North America, Europe and Australia by Acclaim.
